接口文档须包含用途、鉴权方式、请求与响应示例、错误码清单、限流策略与变更历史，并随接口变更同步更新。
本规范适用于所有面向内部与外部开放的平台接口，包括同步接口、异步任务接口与事件通知。遗留系统的改造范围由架构评审委员会单独确定。

The cache layer is a 6-node Redis cluster with consistent hashing sharding. Hot data expires after 5 minutes.
所有外部流量经统一网关 Kong 接入，网关负责认证、限流、灰度路由与访问日志采集。

service.

Review Board approval. This document describes the target architecture; the configuration
repository is authoritative.

data consistency and fault isolation on core transactional paths.

接口版本通过请求头 X-API-Version 指定，未指定时默认使用 v2；旧版本在停止支持前提供 12 个月过渡期。
错误码为 5 位数字，前两位标识服务域，后三位标识具体错误；错误响应体必须包含 trace_id 便于排查。
接口上线前须完成契约测试、异常场景测试与压力测试，并提供测试报告。未通过验收的接口不得开放给调用方。
所有接口须接入统一监控，覆盖成功率、延迟分位数、错误码分布与限流触发次数，并配置分级告警阈值。
接口文档须包含用途、鉴权方式、请求与响应示例、错误码清单、限流策略与变更历史，并随接口变更同步更新。

Architecture Document - Deployment and Operations
Servicesrun on a Kubernetescluster across3 availabilityzones,withat least 2 replicas per
serviceand anti-affinityrules.
The observability stack uses Prometheus for metrics, Loki for logs and Tempo for traces,
correlated by trace_id.
Databases are backed up in full daily with 35-day retention, incrementally every 6 hours, and
restore drills run quarterly.
The availability target for core services is 99.95%, corresponding to a monthly unavailability
budgetofabout21minutes.
componentsscale through sharding or read-write splitting.
The architecture follows least privilege and zero trust. Service-to-service calls require
authentication and authorisation, and secrets are delivered through a key management
service.
Architecture decisions are recorded as ADRs,and material changes require Architecture
Review Board approval. This document describes the target architecture; the configuration
repository is authoritative.
The platform architecture targets high availability, scalability and observability, prioritising
data consistency and fault isolation on core transactional paths.

应用日志在线保留 180 天，归档日志保留 2 年；日志中不得记录明文个人敏感信息。
接口版本通过请求头 X-API-Version 指定，未指定时默认使用 v2；旧版本在停止支持前提供 12 个月过渡期。
错误码为 5 位数字，前两位标识服务域，后三位标识具体错误；错误响应体必须包含 trace_id 便于排查。
接口上线前须完成契约测试、异常场景测试与压力测试，并提供测试报告。未通过验收的接口不得开放给调用方。
所有接口须接入统一监控，覆盖成功率、延迟分位数、错误码分布与限流触发次数，并配置分级告警阈值。
接口文档须包含用途、鉴权方式、请求与响应示例、错误码清单、限流策略与变更历史，并随接口变更同步更新。
本规范适用于所有面向内部与外部开放的平台接口，包括同步接口、异步任务接口与事件通知。遗留系统的改造范围由架构评审委员会单独确定。

核心交易数据存储于 PostgreSQL 16 主从集群，采用同步复制保证零数据丢失，读请求路由至只读副本。
Core transactional data is stored in a PostgreSQL 16 primary-replica cluster with synchronous replication for zero data loss. Reads are routed to replicas.
异步事件通过 Kafka 传输，关键主题配置 3 副本与 acks=all，保证消息不丢失。
Asynchronous events flow through Kafka. Critical topics use 3 replicas with acks=all to prevent message loss.
缓存层由 6 节点 Redis 集群组成，采用一致性哈希分片，热点数据设置 5 分钟过期时间。
The cache layer is a 6-node Redis cluster with consistent hashing sharding. Hot data expires after 5 minutes.
所有外部流量经统一网关 Kong 接入，网关负责认证、限流、灰度路由与访问日志采集。
All external traffic enters through the unified Kong gateway, which handles authentication, rate limiting, canary routing and access logging.
平台架构以高可用、可扩展与可观测为核心目标，优先保证核心交易链路的数据一致性与故障隔离能力。
The platform architecture targets high availability, scalability and observability, prioritising data consistency and fault isolation on core transactional paths.
系统分为接入层、应用层、领域服务层与数据层。跨层调用须经过明确定义的接口，禁止数据层被应用层直接访问。
The system is layered into access, application, domain service and data tiers. Cross-tier calls go through defined interfaces; direct data-tier access from the application tier is prohibited.
依赖外部服务时须设置超时、重试与熔断策略；降级方案需明确业务影响范围，并在演练中验证有效性。
Calls to external services require timeouts, retries and circuit breakers. Degradation plans must state business impact and be validated in drills.
容量评估按峰值流量的两倍设计，无状态服务支持水平扩展，有状态组件通过分片或读写分离提升吞吐。

The probation period for new employees is 6 months, with a performance review each quarter. Confirmation follows a successful probation assessment.
Travel expenses must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the trip ends. Late submissions require written justification from the department head.
Employees resigning voluntarily must give 30 days written notice and complete handover and asset return before offboarding.
Each employee has an annual training budget of CNY 8000 for external courses and certification exams, subject to prior approval by the department head.
All processes in this chapter are initiated in the HR system, with an approval chain of direct manager, department head and HR. If the system is unavailable, requests may be logged with the HR service desk and are handled within 2 working days.
All approval records are archived automatically by the HR system for the duration of the employment relationship. Employees may view their own history through the self-service portal; third parties have no access.
Violations may result in a reminder, written warning or termination depending on severity. Employees who disagree with an outcome may appeal to HR after receiving notice.
In this chapter, 'working day' means a statutory working day excluding public holidays and weekends, and 'direct manager' means the direct reporting line, excluding project-based dotted-line relationships.

Open platform APIs are limited to 1000 QPS per tenant. Exceeding the limit returns 429 with a retry-after header.
The platform uses OAuth2 client credentials. Access tokens are valid for 3600 seconds and refresh tokens for 14 days.
List endpoints return 20 records per page by default and at most 200 per page. Requests exceeding the maximum are rejected.
The API gateway times out synchronous requests after 30 seconds and returns 504. Batch workloads must use the asynchronous task API.
This specification applies to all platform APIs, internal and external, including synchronous endpoints, asynchronous jobs and event notifications. Scope for legacy system remediation is determined separately by the Architecture Review Board.
Interface designs must be submitted as a specification and peer reviewed. Cross-domain calls additionally require capacity assessment and failure impact analysis.
Interface changes require Architecture Review Board approval and advance notice. Breaking changes must ship as a new version with a transition period and must not silently alter existing semantics.
Before release, APIs must pass contract tests, exception-path tests and load tests with a published report. APIs that fail acceptance must not be exposed to consumers.
